title: Regina campaign strategy file
description: Validates regina/library/campaigns/<slug>.json. Source of truth for the intent enum is crm/lib/voice-intents.js — the loader's runtime validator imports INTENT_VALUES from there, and the descriptive `intent.enum` below is informational only. campaign_kind enum lives in crm/migrations/006_reactivation_and_voice.sh (column comment) plus 'ad_hoc' added in R5.

slug.description: Lowercase alphanumeric + underscores. Must match the .json filename and be referenced in eligibility_sql_path.

campaign_kind.description: Persisted on outreach_campaigns.campaign_kind. Drives the 'already contacted' filter in non-anniversary eligibility queries.

intent.description: Voice Service request field. Runtime validator imports the canonical list from crm/lib/voice-intents.js — this enum is descriptive only.

recipient_relationship.description: Overrides the contact's contacts.relationship_type when building the Voice Service payload.

language.description: Phase R is English-only. Spanish drafts deferred to v2.

default_batch_size.description: Default LIMIT for the eligibility query. Operator can override via !batch <slug> n=N.

eligibility_sql_path.description: Path relative to regina/ root (e.g. 'library/campaigns/anniversary.sql'). The .sql file uses :batch_size and :today named params, bound by the loader's bindParams helper.

cadence_note.description: Human-readable cadence — for documentation, not consumed by code.

landing_page_url.description: Stored on outreach_campaigns row at create-time. Pure metadata; not threaded into the Voice Service payload.

prompt_context.description: Voice Service prompt addendum. Prepended to message_context in regina/lib/dossier-context.js.

draft_length.description: Optional per-campaign draft length override. Defaults come from regina/config.json batch.draft_length.

contact_ids.description: Smoke escape hatch ONLY. If present, the loader uses this list directly and skips SQL execution. Real R6 campaigns must use eligibility_sql_path.
